summary: After trouble hits a household, neighbors do small practical favors without being asked.
realLife: Census and AmeriCorps data show about half of people 16 and older helped neighbors informally in the pandemic year, mainly childcare, errands and checks on seniors.
sources: U.S. Census Bureau, volunteering and civic life story: https://census.gov/library/stories/2023/01/volunteering-and-civic-life-in-america.html
inGame: neighbor ties; a trouble record on a household (illness, job loss, damage) can bring neighbor help as a tie event

turns.summary: Several neighbors show up with specific offers.
turns.writesBack: ties warm across the street; journal note

turns.summary: Only one neighbor comes by, and the household remembers it.
People say let us know and do not return.
